# Taperwise

> Marathon, half marathon and 10K plans that adapt to heart rate, HRV and sleep. Live coaching and offline maps on iPhone and Apple Watch. No account, no cloud.

Taperwise is a running app for iPhone and Apple Watch by BitSpire GmbH (Cham, Switzerland). It is not yet released on the App Store. Contact: apps@bitspire.ch
